environment.description: Laravel 10 application deployed on EC2 behind an AWS ALB with standard HTTPS termination. The ALB forwards all traffic on port 443 to the application target group. No additional authentication layers. The /api/v2/partner/validate-token endpoint is publicly accessible. Security groups allow inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0.

config.alb_listener: HTTPS:443, default action forward to target group
